Class LagLink<T>

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.env.LagLink<T>
Type Parameters:
T - what is sent; never changed after it has been put in
public final class LagLink<T> extends Object
What comes over a connection to a server: everything a set number of ticks late, and over one that stutters, now and then nothing at all for a few ticks and then all of it at once. The first is why a player on a server is knocked up by a hit a moment after the hit; the second is why a lagging player stands still and then jumps on.

Things come out in the order they went in.

      public void tick(Random rng, Consumer<? super T> arrive)
